ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding streams involved in the Minnesota childcare fraud scandal.
questions: What were the funding sources for the childcare programs?
How were the funds allocated and managed?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding streams, we may be able to identify patterns of fraud or mismanagement and track the flow of money to uncover potential wrongdoing.
